description: This file defines the `sensors_poll_context_t` structure, which encapsulates the context and operations related to sensor polling in the Android HAL layer. It includes method declarations for activating sensors, setting delays, polling events, batching, flushing, and injecting sensor data, as well as private members such as a pointer to BoschSensor.

classes.name: sensors_poll_context_t
classes.description: A structure that manages sensor polling operations, including activation, delay configuration, event polling, batching, and data injection. It contains a device structure, method declarations, and a private sensor pointer.

methods.name: sensors_poll_context_t
methods.description: Constructor for the sensors_poll_context_t structure, initializes the polling context.

methods.name: sensors_poll_context_t(const sensors_poll_context_t &other)
methods.description: Copy constructor, intended to prevent copying (not explicitly marked as deleted, but implied by comment about cppcheck).

methods.name: activate
methods.description: Activates or deactivates a sensor specified by handle.

methods.name: setDelay
methods.description: Sets the delay (sampling rate) for a specific sensor handle.

methods.name: pollEvents
methods.description: Retrieves sensor events, populating provided data buffer.

methods.name: batch
methods.description: Configures batching parameters for a sensor.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flushes buffered sensor events for a specified handle.

methods.name: inject_sensor_data
methods.description: Injects sensor data, available if API version 1.4 is supported.
